<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"> <span style="font-style: italic;">Methodology</span><br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f929" continuedAt="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f930"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1083" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1084">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"> <br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f930" continuedAt="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f931"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1084" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1085">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;">The weighted-average remaining maturity method (“WARM”) methodology is utilized
          as the basis for the estimation of expected credit losses for consumer segment loans. The WARM method uses a historical average annual charge-off rate. This average annual charge-off rate contains loss content over a historical lookback period
          and is used as a foundation for estimating the credit loss reserve for the remaining outstanding balances of loans in a segment at the balance sheet date. The average annual charge-off rate is applied to the contractual term, further adjusted for
          estimated prepayments, to determine the unadjusted historical charge-off rate. The calculation of the unadjusted historical charge-off rate is then adjusted for current conditions and for reasonable and supportable forecast periods. Adjustments
          to historical loss information are made for differences in current loan-specific risk characteristics such as differences in underwriting standards, portfolio mix, delinquency level, or term as well as for changes in environmental conditions,
          such as changes in unemployment rates, property values, or other relevant factors. These qualitative factors serve to compensate for additional areas of uncertainty inherent in the portfolio that are not reflected in our historic loss factors.<br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f931" continuedAt="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f932"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1085" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1086">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"> <br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f932" continuedAt="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f933"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1086" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1087">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"> A discounted cash flow (“DCF”) methodology is utilized to calculate expected
          cash flows for the life of each individual loan, with the exception of consumer segment loans. The discounted present value of expected cash flow is then compared to the loan’s amortized cost basis to determine the credit loss estimate. 
          Individual loan results are aggregated at the pool level in determining total reserves for each loan pool.<br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f933" continuedAt="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f934"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1087" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1088">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"> <br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f934" continuedAt="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f935"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1088" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1089">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"> The primary inputs used to calculate expected cash flows include historical
          loss rates which reflect probability of default (“PD”) and loss given default (“LGD”), and prepayment rates.  The historical look-back period is a key factor in the calculation of the PD rate and is based on management’s assessment of current and
          forecasted conditions and may vary by loan pool.  LGD rates generally reflect the historical average net loss rate by loan pool.  Expected cash flows are further adjusted to incorporate the impact of loan prepayments which will vary by loan
          segment and interest rate conditions.  In general, prepayment rates are based on peer group benchmark reporting of observed prepayment rates occurring in the loan portfolios of the peer group, and consideration of forecasted interest rates.<br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f935" continuedAt="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f936"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1089" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1090">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"> <br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f936" continuedAt="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f937"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1090" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1091">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"> <span style="font-style: italic;">Forecast Factors</span><br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f937" continuedAt="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f938"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1091" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1092">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-style: italic;"> <br/>
          </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f938" continuedAt="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f939"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1092" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1093">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"> Adjustments are made to incorporate the impact of forecasted conditions. 
          Certain assumptions are also applied, including the length of the forecast and reversion periods. The forecast period is the period within which management is able to make a reasonable and supportable assessment of future conditions. The
          reversion period is the period beyond which management believes it can develop a reasonable and supportable forecast, and bridges the gap between the forecast period and the use of historical default and loss rates. The remainder period reflects
          the remaining life of the loan. The length of the forecast and reversion periods are periodically evaluated and based on management’s assessment of current and forecasted conditions and may vary by loan pool. For purposes of developing a
          reasonable and supportable assessment of future conditions, management utilizes established industry and economic data points and sources, with the forecasted unemployment rate being a significant factor. PD rates for the forecast period will be
          adjusted accordingly based on management’s assessment of future conditions. PD rates for the remainder period will reflect the historical mean PD rate. Reversion period PD rates reflect the difference between forecast and remainder period PD
          rates closed using a straight-line adjustment over the reversion period.<br/>
          <br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f939" continuedAt="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f940"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1093" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1094">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"> <span style="font-style: italic;">Qualitative Factors</span><br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f940" continuedAt="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f941"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1094" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1095">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"> <br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f941" continuedAt="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f942"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1095" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1096">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"> Loss rates are further adjusted to account for other risk factors that impact
          loan defaults and losses. These basis point adjustments are based on management’s assessment of trends and conditions that impact credit risk and resulting credit losses, more specifically internal and external factors that are independent of and
          not reflected in the quantitative loss rate calculations. Risk factors management considers in this assessment include trends in underwriting standards, nature/volume/terms of loan originations, past due loans, loan review systems, collateral
          valuations, concentrations, legal/regulatory/political conditions, and the unforeseen impact of natural disasters.<br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f942" continuedAt="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f943"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1096" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1097">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"> <br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <div class="BRPFPageBreakArea" style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;">

              <div style="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: center;">Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements<br/>

        <ix:continuation id="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f943" continuedAt="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f944"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1097" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1098">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"> <span style="font-style: italic;">Purchased Loans</span><br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f944" continuedAt="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f945"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1098" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1099">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-style: italic;"> <br/>
          </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f945" continuedAt="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f946"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d1099" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10100">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"> When a loan portfolio is purchased, an allowance is established for those loans
          considered purchased with more-than-insignificant credit deterioration (“PCD”), and those not considered purchased with more-than-insignificant credit deterioration (“non-PCD”). The allowance established utilizes the same risk factors discussed
          above for our non-acquired allowance. The allowance established for non-PCD loans is recognized through provision expense upon acquisition, whereas the allowance established for loans considered PCD at acquisition is offset by an increase in the
          basis of the acquired loans. Any subsequent increases and decreases in the allowance related to acquired loans are recognized through provision expense, with future charge-offs recorded to the allowance.<br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f946" continuedAt="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f947"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10100" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10101">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"> <br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f947" continuedAt="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f948"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10101" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10102">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"> <span style="font-style: italic;">Allowance for Credit Losses on Off-Balance
            Sheet Credit Exposures</span><br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f948" continuedAt="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f949"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10102" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10103">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"> <br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_64dd18fa8baf4fd2ac3583cf5fde26f949"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10103" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10104">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"> The Company estimates expected credit losses over the contractual period in
          which it is exposed to credit risk through a contractual obligation to extend credit, unless that obligation is unconditionally cancellable by the Company. The allowance for credit losses on off-balance sheet credit exposures is adjusted as a
          provision for credit loss expense and is recorded in interest payable and other liabilities. The estimate includes consideration of the likelihood that funding will occur and an estimate of expected credit losses on commitments expected to be
          funded over its estimated life and applies the same estimated loss rate as determined for current outstanding loan balances by segment.<br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

        <ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10104" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10105">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"> <br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation>

        <ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentPolicyTextBlock" id="Text_196e42df08b3468e81108713df5e08a4" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_f175a17ee71a4debb7d3cf6dcf3f78911"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10105" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10106">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"> <span style="font-style: italic; font-weight: bold;">Premises and Equipment</span>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:nonNumeric>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_f175a17ee71a4debb7d3cf6dcf3f78911" continuedAt="Text_f175a17ee71a4debb7d3cf6dcf3f78912"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10106" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10107">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-style: italic;"> <br/>
          </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_f175a17ee71a4debb7d3cf6dcf3f78912"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10107" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10108">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"> Premises and equipment are stated at cost, less accumulated depreciation.
          Depreciation is charged to operating expense and is computed using the straight-line method over the estimated useful lives of the assets. Maintenance and repairs are charged to expense as incurred while improvements are capitalized. Premises and
          equipment is tested for impairment if events or changes in circumstances occur that indicate that the carrying amount of any premises and equipment may not be recoverable. Premises that are identified to be sold are transferred to other real
          estate owned at the lower of their carrying amounts or their fair values less estimated costs to sell. Any losses on premises identified to be sold are charged to operating expense.<br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10108" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10109">
<div>

        <span style="font-weight: normal;"> </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
        <div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left;"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10109" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10110">
<div>   </div>
</ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10110" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10111"><ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:LesseeLeasesPolicyTextBlock" id="Text_8da6b0e8880b4d9f854ca24e580efc81" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_91a18c956f1a4cd486cc9cedd6adb7ae1">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"> <span style="font-style: italic; font-weight: bold;">Leases</span> </div>
</ix:nonNumeric></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10111" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10112"><ix:continuation id="Text_91a18c956f1a4cd486cc9cedd6adb7ae1" continuedAt="Text_91a18c956f1a4cd486cc9cedd6adb7ae2">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-style: italic;"> <br/>
            </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10112" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10113"><ix:continuation id="Text_91a18c956f1a4cd486cc9cedd6adb7ae2">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"> Certain operating leases are included as right of use lease assets in
            interest receivable and other assets on the consolidated balance sheet and a related lease liability is included in interest payable and other liabilities on the consolidated balance sheet. Right of use assets represent the Company’s right to
            use an underlying asset for the lease term and lease liabilities represent the Company’s obligation to make lease payments arising from the lease. The lease liability is measured as the present value of the unpaid lease payments, and the right
            of use assets value is derived from the calculation of the lease liability. To calculate the discount rate for each lease, the Company uses the rate implicit in the lease if available, otherwise an appropriate Federal Home Loan Bank (“FHLB”)
            advance borrowing rate is used that correlates with the term of the lease.<br/>
          </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10113" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10114">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;"> <br/>
          </div>
</ix:continuation>
        </div>

        <ix:continuation id="Text_f55352324d1b4359a964a6d27b8c1bdf2"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10116" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10117">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">Non-marketable equity securities consist primarily of Federal Home Loan Bank of Topeka stock and Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City stock and
          are required investments for financial institutions that are members of the FHLB and Federal Reserve systems.  The required investment in common stock is based on a predetermined formula, carried at cost and evaluated for impairment.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

<div style="font-style: italic; font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left;">Long-Lived Asset Impairment</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:nonNumeric>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_773b80ccca194178a7fcc022c519d8061" continuedAt="Text_773b80ccca194178a7fcc022c519d8062"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10119" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10120">

</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_773b80ccca194178a7fcc022c519d8062" continuedAt="Text_773b80ccca194178a7fcc022c519d8063"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10120" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10121">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">The Company evaluates the recoverability of the carrying value of long-lived assets whenever events or circumstances indicate the carrying
          amount may not be recoverable.  If a long-lived asset is tested for recoverability and the undiscounted estimated future cash flows is expected to result from the use and eventual disposition of the asset is less than the carrying amount of the
          asset, the asset cost is adjusted to fair value and an impairment loss is recognized as the amount by which the carrying amount of a long-lived asset exceeds its fair value.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_773b80ccca194178a7fcc022c519d8063" continuedAt="Text_773b80ccca194178a7fcc022c519d8064"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10121" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10122">

        <ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:FinanceLoanAndLeaseReceivablesHeldForInvestmentsForeclosedAssetsPolicy" id="Text_4eedaedfa7114015897b0c4d4d30b616" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_4ae19404819a41ed967e9dd91bd788e61"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10126" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10127">
<div style="font-style: italic; font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left;">Foreclosed Assets Held for Sale</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:nonNumeric>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_4ae19404819a41ed967e9dd91bd788e61" continuedAt="Text_4ae19404819a41ed967e9dd91bd788e62"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10127" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10128">

</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_4ae19404819a41ed967e9dd91bd788e62"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10128" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10129">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">Foreclosed assets held for sale consist of assets acquired through, or in lieu of, loan foreclosure and are initially recorded at fair value,
          less cost to sell at the date of foreclosure, establishing a new cost basis.  Subsequent to foreclosure, valuations are periodically performed by management and the assets are carried at the lower of carrying amount of fair value less costs to
          sell.  Revenue and expenses from operations and changes in the valuation allowance are included in current operations.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

        <ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10129" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10130">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left;"> </div>
</ix:continuation>
        <div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">
          <ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationsPolicy" id="Text_68b8e691a2194bc38924259c2f5b82ac" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_60d1df1b2e9f41aaa04dac951f7429bc1"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10130" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10131">
<div style="font-style: italic; font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left;">Business Combinations</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:nonNumeric>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_60d1df1b2e9f41aaa04dac951f7429bc1" continuedAt="Text_60d1df1b2e9f41aaa04dac951f7429bc2"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10131" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10132">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left;"> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_60d1df1b2e9f41aaa04dac951f7429bc2"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10132" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10133">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">The acquisition method of accounting is used for business combinations. Under the acquisition accounting method, the acquiring Company
            recognizes 100% of the assets acquired and liabilities assumed at the acquisition date fair value. The excess of fair value of the consideration transferred over the acquisition date fair value of net assets acquired is recorded as goodwill.<br/>
          </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

          <ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10133" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10134">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"> <br/>
          </div>
</ix:continuation>
        </div>


        <ix:nonNumeric name="bsvn:AssetAcquisitionPolicyTextBlock" id="Text_42ff1ca6773741559316f44919736d91" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_8ca0e8e590434cbd9ef64a5f111af26f1"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10134" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10135">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"> <span style="font-style: italic; font-weight: bold;">Asset Acquisition</span><br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:nonNumeric>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_8ca0e8e590434cbd9ef64a5f111af26f1" continuedAt="Text_8ca0e8e590434cbd9ef64a5f111af26f2"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10135" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10136">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_8ca0e8e590434cbd9ef64a5f111af26f2"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10136" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10137">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: normal;">The fair value of assets acquired is measured and recognized at the amount of monetary assets or liabilities exchanged, which
            generally includes the transaction costs of the assets acquired. No gain or loss is recognized unless the fair value of any noncash assets given as consideration differs from the assets carrying amounts on the acquiring entities books.</span><br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

        <ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10137" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10138">
<div style="font-style: italic; font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left;"> <br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation>

        <ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:GoodwillAndIntangibleAssetsPolicyTextBlock" id="Text_08d410663bdc461593c123ca92a7892b" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_2a089e9b7718461d8232d4a2ecee66381"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10138" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10139">
<div style="font-style: italic; font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left;">Goodwill and Intangible Assets</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:nonNumeric>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_2a089e9b7718461d8232d4a2ecee66381" continuedAt="Text_2a089e9b7718461d8232d4a2ecee66382"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10139" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10140">

</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_2a089e9b7718461d8232d4a2ecee66382" continuedAt="Text_2a089e9b7718461d8232d4a2ecee66383"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10140" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10141">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">Intangible assets totaled $<ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:IntangibleAssetsNetExcludingGoodwill" id="Fact_48e3d22d886e42efa9a7a33ab86aeee0" contextRef="c20241231" unitRef="U001" decimals="-3" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">878</ix:nonFraction>,000



          and goodwill, net of accumulated amortization totaled $<ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:Goodwill" id="Fact_a3e306ac965f47308f3cd97bc3a3b041" contextRef="c20241231" unitRef="U001" decimals="-5" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">8.5</ix:nonFraction> million for the year ended December 31, 2024, compared to intangible assets
          of $<ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:IntangibleAssetsNetExcludingGoodwill" id="Fact_dba4690964e640e4af573c22f26f1912" contextRef="c20231231" unitRef="U001" decimals="-5" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">1.0</ix:nonFraction> million and goodwill, net of accumulated amortization of $<ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:Goodwill" id="Fact_4ee079f543164629a6c74ac06ee4e284" contextRef="c20231231" unitRef="U001" decimals="-5" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">8.5</ix:nonFraction> million for the year ended December 31, 2023.<br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_2a089e9b7718461d8232d4a2ecee66383" continuedAt="Text_2a089e9b7718461d8232d4a2ecee66384"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10141" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10142">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">
          <ix:continuation id="Text_2a089e9b7718461d8232d4a2ecee66384" continuedAt="Text_2a089e9b7718461d8232d4a2ecee66385"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10142" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10143">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">Goodwill resulting from a business combination represents the excess of the fair value of the consideration transferred over the fair value of
            the net assets acquired and liabilities assumed as of the acquisition date. Goodwill is tested annually for impairment or more frequently if other impairment indicators are present.  If the implied fair value of goodwill is lower than its
            carrying amount, a goodwill impairment is indicated and goodwill is written down to its implied fair value.  Subsequent increases in goodwill value are not recognized in the accompanying consolidated financial statements.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        </div>

        <ix:continuation id="Text_2a089e9b7718461d8232d4a2ecee66385" continuedAt="Text_2a089e9b7718461d8232d4a2ecee66386"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10143" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10144">
<div><span style="font-weight: normal;"> </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_2a089e9b7718461d8232d4a2ecee66386" continuedAt="Text_2a089e9b7718461d8232d4a2ecee66387"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10144" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10145">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left;"> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_2a089e9b7718461d8232d4a2ecee66387" continuedAt="Text_2a089e9b7718461d8232d4a2ecee66388"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10145" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10146">
<div><span style="font-weight: normal;"> </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_2a089e9b7718461d8232d4a2ecee66388"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10146" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10147">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">Other intangible assets consist of core deposit intangible assets and are amortized on a straight-line basis based on an estimated useful life
          of <ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetUsefulLife" id="Fact_4fad3893af994309bc4aff60dc010712" contextRef="c20241231_FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis_CoreDepositsMember" format="ixt-sec:duryear">10</ix:nonNumeric> years.  Such assets are periodically evaluated as to the recoverability of their carrying values.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10147" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10148">
<div>

        <span style="font-weight: normal;"> </span></div>
</ix:continuation>

<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left;"> </div>
</ix:continuation>

        <ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:SegmentReportingPolicyPolicyTextBlock" id="Text_c2d140fddbca4eeb96d1d95e333e4a4b" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_b15762d02b1d4371adda55df03a218df1"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10149" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10150">
<div style="font-style: italic; font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left;">Segments</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:nonNumeric>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_b15762d02b1d4371adda55df03a218df1" continuedAt="Text_b15762d02b1d4371adda55df03a218df2"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10150" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10151">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left;"> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_b15762d02b1d4371adda55df03a218df2"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10151" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10152">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">The Company’s chief operating decision-maker (“CODM”) is the Chief Executive Officer. Operating segments are defined as components of a business
          about which separate financial information is available and evaluated regularly by the CODM in deciding how to allocate resources and assess performance.  While the CODM monitors the revenue streams of the various products and services offered by
          the Bank, the Company’s operations are managed and financial performance is evaluated on a Company-wide basis as a single reportable operating segment, which is the Bank.<br/>
          <br/>
          Discrete financial information, with a full allocation of revenue, costs, and capital from key corporate functions, is not available at a level other than on a Company-wide basis. Although the CODM has some limited financial information about the
          Company’s various financial products and services, this information is not complete and is insufficient for making resource allocation decisions or performance assessments at a more granular level. Therefore, management considers all financial
          service operations to be aggregated within <ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:NumberOfReportableSegments" id="Fact_2ed84bbe4a854a45bd9eb7887bf0c1b5" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" unitRef="U005" decimals="INF" scale="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen">one</ix:nonFraction> reportable operating segment, the Bank, and evaluates financial performance on a
          company-wide basis using net income as reported on the Consolidated Statement of Income.  The measure of segment assets is total assets, as reported on the Consolidated Statements of Condition. The CODM uses net income to monitor budget versus
          actual results and in the determination of allocating resources across the Company.<br/>
          <br/>
          The Company’s single reportable segment, the Bank, generates revenues primarily from interest income from financial instruments and non-interest income and service charges on deposit accounts.  There are no intra-entity sales or transfers within
          the Company. Management continues to evaluate the Company’s business units for potential separate reporting in the future as facts and circumstances evolve.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

        <div>

          <ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationOptionAndIncentivePlansPolicy" id="Text_0f04b98313404fd895ec5f04bf0b5c6d" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_793d8aa8269140fdbe340afc3e117c071"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10153" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10154">
<div style="font-style: italic; font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">Stock-based Compensation</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:nonNumeric>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_793d8aa8269140fdbe340afc3e117c071" continuedAt="Text_793d8aa8269140fdbe340afc3e117c072"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10154" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10155">
<div style="font-style: italic; font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"> <br/>

          <ix:continuation id="Text_793d8aa8269140fdbe340afc3e117c072" continuedAt="Text_793d8aa8269140fdbe340afc3e117c073"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10155" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10156">
<div><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"> </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_793d8aa8269140fdbe340afc3e117c073"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10156" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10157">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">The Company recognizes stock-based compensation as
            salaries and employee benefits expense in the consolidated statements of comprehensive income based on the fair value of the Company’s stock options and restricted stock units (“RSU’s”) on the measurement date, which, for the Company, is the
            date of the grant. The fair value of each option grant was estimated on the date of grant using the Black-Scholes option-pricing model and was based on certain assumptions including risk-free rate of return, dividend yield, stock price
            volatility and the expected term. The fair value of each RSU granted is equal to the market price of the Company’s stock at the date of grant. The fair value of each option and RSU is expensed over its vesting period.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

          <ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10157" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10158">

            </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
        </div>


        <ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:IncomeTaxPolicyTextBlock" id="Text_a59e8c05a7e342789b6bb052f30ca823" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_fc91087dfd1a4f5a999cf7096faceebe1"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10158" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10159">
<div style="font-style: italic; font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left;">Income Taxes</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:nonNumeric>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_fc91087dfd1a4f5a999cf7096faceebe1" continuedAt="Text_fc91087dfd1a4f5a999cf7096faceebe2"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10159" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10160">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left;"> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_fc91087dfd1a4f5a999cf7096faceebe2" continuedAt="Text_fc91087dfd1a4f5a999cf7096faceebe3"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10160" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10161">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">The Company uses a comprehensive model for recognizing, measuring, presenting, and disclosing in the financial statements tax positions taken or
          expected to be taken on a tax return. A tax position is recognized as a benefit only if it is ‘‘more likely than not’’ that the tax position would be sustained in a tax examination, with a tax examination being presumed to occur. The amount
          recognized is the largest amount of tax benefit that is greater than 50% likely of being realized on examination. For tax positions not meeting the “more likely than not” test, no tax benefit is recorded.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_fc91087dfd1a4f5a999cf7096faceebe3" continuedAt="Text_fc91087dfd1a4f5a999cf7096faceebe4"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10161" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10162">
<div><span style="font-weight: normal;"> </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_fc91087dfd1a4f5a999cf7096faceebe4" continuedAt="Text_fc91087dfd1a4f5a999cf7096faceebe5"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10162" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10163">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left;"> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_fc91087dfd1a4f5a999cf7096faceebe5" continuedAt="Text_fc91087dfd1a4f5a999cf7096faceebe6"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10163" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10164">
<div><span style="font-weight: normal;"> </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_fc91087dfd1a4f5a999cf7096faceebe6" continuedAt="Text_fc91087dfd1a4f5a999cf7096faceebe7"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10164" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10165">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">The Company recognizes interest accrued and penalties related to unrecognized tax benefits in tax expense. During the years ended December 31,
          2024, 2023 and 2022, the Company recognized <ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltiesAndInterestAccrued" id="Fact_ae90e2e547fa45a2af99d12f1fc1c73f" contextRef="c20221231" unitRef="U001" decimals="-3" scale="3" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltiesAndInterestAccrued" id="Fact_63d52d06db4746f7b1231a43d4568cb5" contextRef="c20241231" unitRef="U001" decimals="-3" scale="3" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltiesAndInterestAccrued" id="Fact_55aa2e3a98cb48eab8ddc9380dc1bbe5" contextRef="c20231231" unitRef="U001" decimals="-3" scale="3" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen">no</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction> interest and penalties.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_fc91087dfd1a4f5a999cf7096faceebe7" continuedAt="Text_fc91087dfd1a4f5a999cf7096faceebe8"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10165" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10166">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
          </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">
          <ix:continuation id="Text_fc91087dfd1a4f5a999cf7096faceebe8"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10166" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10167">
<div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The Company or one of its subsidiaries file income tax returns in the U.S. federal jurisdiction and various state jurisdictions.  We are no
            longer subject to U.S. federal or state tax examinations for years before 2021.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

        </div>

          <ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:ComprehensiveIncomePolicyPolicyTextBlock" id="Text_cd5760a757464e13b129100f4ccd18c9" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_f9f394624c414a648d562d329cde507e1"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10168" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10169">
<div style="font-style: italic; font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left;">Comprehensive Income</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:nonNumeric>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_f9f394624c414a648d562d329cde507e1" continuedAt="Text_f9f394624c414a648d562d329cde507e2"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10169" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10170">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left;"> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_f9f394624c414a648d562d329cde507e2"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10170" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10171">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">Comprehensive income includes all changes in shareholders’ equity during a period, except those resulting from transactions with shareholders.
            Besides net income, other components of the Company’s comprehensive income includes the after tax effect of changes in the net unrealized gain/loss on debt securities available-for-sale. The Company’s policy is to release material stranded tax
            effects included in accumulated other comprehensive income on a specific identification basis.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

        </div>
<ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10171" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10172"><ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerPolicyTextBlock" id="Text_955edc9e446b49c5b99063552e3fd426" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_b26d4ad1ca6447d9a3d89197009fd75f1">
<div>
        <br/></div>
</ix:nonNumeric></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10172" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10173"><ix:continuation id="Text_b26d4ad1ca6447d9a3d89197009fd75f1" continuedAt="Text_b26d4ad1ca6447d9a3d89197009fd75f2">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"> <span style="font-style: italic;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">Revenue Recognition </span></span><br/>
          <br/>
          In addition to lending and related activities, the Company offers various services to customers that generate revenue. Contract performance typically occurs in one year or less. Incremental costs of obtaining a contract are expensed when incurred
          when the amortization period is one year or less. <br/>
          <br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10173" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10174"><ix:continuation id="Text_b26d4ad1ca6447d9a3d89197009fd75f2" continuedAt="Text_b26d4ad1ca6447d9a3d89197009fd75f3">
<div><span style="font-weight: normal;"> </span>
         <span style="font-style: italic;"> </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10174" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10175"><ix:continuation id="Text_b26d4ad1ca6447d9a3d89197009fd75f3" continuedAt="Text_b26d4ad1ca6447d9a3d89197009fd75f4">
<div style="font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left; font-style: italic;">Service and transaction fees on depository accounts</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10175" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10176"><ix:continuation id="Text_b26d4ad1ca6447d9a3d89197009fd75f4" continuedAt="Text_b26d4ad1ca6447d9a3d89197009fd75f5">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left;"> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10176" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10177"><ix:continuation id="Text_b26d4ad1ca6447d9a3d89197009fd75f5" continuedAt="Text_b26d4ad1ca6447d9a3d89197009fd75f6">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">Customers often pay certain fees to the bank to access the cash on deposit including certain non-transactional fees such as account maintenance
          or dormancy fees, and certain transaction based fees such as ATM, wire transfer, or foreign exchange fees. Revenue is recognized when the transactions occur or as services are performed over primarily monthly or quarterly periods. Payment is
          typically received in the period the transactions occur, or in some cases, within <ix:nonNumeric name="bsvn:PaymentPeriodForTransactionsOccur" id="Fact_e4a52a8b163d4acdbffa22ac90f9a494" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" format="ixt-sec:durday">90</ix:nonNumeric> days of the service period.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left;"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10177" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10178"><ix:continuation id="Text_b26d4ad1ca6447d9a3d89197009fd75f6" continuedAt="Text_b26d4ad1ca6447d9a3d89197009fd75f7">
<div> 
          </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

        <ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10180" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10181"><ix:continuation id="Text_b26d4ad1ca6447d9a3d89197009fd75f9">
<div style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">Interchange fees, or “swipe” fees, are charges that merchants pay to the processors who, in turn, share that revenue with us and other
          card-issuing banks for processing electronic payment transactions. Interchange fees represent the portion of the debit card transaction amount that the card issuer retains to compensate it for processing transactions and providing rewards.
          Interchange fees are settled and recognized on a daily or monthly basis. Interchange fees are included with noninterest income and recorded net of related expenses as the Bank acts as an agent, introducing the customer transactions to the
          processor.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: bold; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: italic; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"> Summary of Significant Accounting Policies--Specific to Production of Oil and Natural Gas Reserves Operations</span><br/>
        </div>

        <ix:continuation id="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af1" continuedAt="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af2"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10183" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10184">

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"> <span style="font-style: italic; font-weight: normal;">Use of Estimates</span><br/>
        </div>

        <ix:continuation id="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af3" continuedAt="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af4"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10185" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10186">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-style: italic;"> <br/>
          </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af4" continuedAt="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af5"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10186" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10187">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"> <span style="font-weight: normal;">Significant items subject to estimates and assumptions include, the proved oil, and natural gas and NGL reserves used in the
            valuation of oil and gas properties, asset retirement obligations, fair value of derivatives and revenue accruals. It is possible these estimates could be revised in the near term and these revisions could be material.</span><br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af5" continuedAt="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af6"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10187" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10188">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: normal;"> <br/>
          </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af6" continuedAt="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af7"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10188" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10189">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"> <span style="font-weight: normal;">The Company’s estimates of oil, natural gas and NGL reserves are, by necessity, projections based on geologic and engineering
            data, and there are uncertainties inherent in the interpretation of such data, as well as the projection of future rates of production. Reserve engineering is a subjective process of estimating underground accumulations of oil, natural gas, and
            NGL that are difficult to measure. The accuracy of any reserve estimate is a function of the quality of available data, engineering and geological interpretation and judgment. Estimates of economically recoverable oil, natural gas and NGL
            reserves and future net cash flows necessarily depend upon a number of variable factors and assumptions, such as historical production from the area compared with production from other producing areas, the assumed effect of regulations by
            governmental agencies, and assumptions governing future oil, natural gas, and NGL prices, future operating costs, severance taxes, and workover costs, all of which may in fact vary considerably from actual results. For these reasons, estimates
            of the economically recoverable quantities of expected oil, natural gas, and NGL attributable to any particular group of properties, classifications of such reserves based on risk of recovery, and estimates of the future net cash flows may vary
            substantially. Any significant variance in the assumptions could materially affect the estimated quantity of the reserves, which could affect the carrying value of the Company’s oil, natural gas, and NGL properties and/or the rate of depletion
            related to the oil, natural gas, and NGL properties.<br/>
          </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af7" continuedAt="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af8"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10189" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10190">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: normal;"> <br/>
          </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af8" continuedAt="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af9"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10190" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10191">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: normal;"> <span style="font-style: italic;">Accounts Receivable<br/>
              <br/>
            </span></span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af9" continuedAt="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af10"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10191" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10192">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: normal;"> The Company’s oil and gas related accounts receivable primarily consists of oil, natural gas and NGL receivables and joint
            interest billings to our partners for their share of expenses on projects for which we are the operator. These balances are generated when estimating and accruing for expected oil, natural gas and NGL sales, upon receipt of oil, natural gas and
            NGL sales and when our cost is cutback to our joint interest partners.  The oil and gas related accounts receivable balance is included in “Interest receivable and other assets” on the consolidated balances sheets.<br/>
          </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af10" continuedAt="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af11"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10192" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10193">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: normal;"> <br/>
          </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af11" continuedAt="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af12"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10193" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10194">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: normal;"> Additionally, due to the creditworthiness of our purchasers, we do not have any allowance for doubtful accounts recorded and do
            not expect to write off any portion of our oil and gas related accounts receivable.<br/>
          </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

        <div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"><ix:continuation id="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af17" continuedAt="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af18"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10199" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10200">
<div><span style="font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"> </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;">The Company’s oil and gas related accounts payable balance primarily consists of trade payables owed to vendors that
            provide services and equipment for the wells and assets that we operate. The oil and gas related accounts payable balance is included in “Interest payable and other liabilities” on the consolidated balances sheets.<br/>

        <ix:continuation id="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af23" continuedAt="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af24"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10205" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10206">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><span style="font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;"> We
            recognize revenue from the sale of oil, natural gas and NGLs in the period that the performance obligations are satisfied in accordance with ASC 606. Our performance obligations are primarily comprised of the delivery of oil, natural gas or
            NGLs at a delivery point (pipeline, railcar or truck). Each barrel of oil, MMBtu of natural gas or other unit of measure is separately identifiable and represents a distinct performance obligation to which the transaction price is allocated.
            The transaction price used to recognize revenue is a function of the contract billing terms. Revenue is invoiced, if required, by calendar month based on volumes at contractually based rates with payment typically received within <ix:nonNumeric name="bsvn:MaximumPaymentPeriodForRevenueInvoiced" id="Fact_2d3766458711456fac32c110a9c78631" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" format="ixt-sec:durday">30</ix:nonNumeric> days of the end of the production month. Performance obligations are satisfied at a point in time once control of the product has been
            transferred to the customer through monthly delivery of oil, natural gas and NGLs. Revenue from the sale of oil, natural gas and NGLs is included in “Other” noninterest income on the consolidated statements of comprehensive income, and taxes
            assessed by governmental authorities on oil, natural gas and NGL sales are included in “Other” noninterest expense on the consolidated statements of comprehensive income.<br/>
          </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

Costs incurred by the Company related to the acquisition of oil and gas properties and the cost of
            drilling development wells are capitalized. Costs incurred to maintain wells and related equipment, delay rentals, lease and well operating costs are charged to expense as incurred. Gains and losses arising from sales of production are

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><span style="font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;">
            Capitalized acquisition costs attributable to proved oil and gas properties are depleted by formation or field using the unit-of-production method based on proved reserves. Capitalized development costs, including asset retirement obligations,
            are amortized by producing unit, based on proved developed producing reserves. Depletion, depreciation, and amortization expense related to proved oil and gas properties was $<ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsDepreciationDepletionAndAmortizationAndValuationProvisions" id="Fact_a1345f95c715411c9b778ac63a37317f" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" unitRef="U001" decimals="-5" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">2.7</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsDepreciationDepletionAndAmortizationAndValuationProvisions" id="Fact_191b95e0d6094531804cf59d03f8da11" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U001" decimals="-5" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">3.6</ix:nonFraction> million for the years ended December 31,
            2024 and December 31, 2023, respectively, and is included in “Other” noninterest expense on the consolidated statements of comprehensive income.<br/>
          </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af35" continuedAt="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af36"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10217" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10218">

        <ix:continuation id="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af38" continuedAt="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af39"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10220" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10221">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><span style="font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;">
            Capitalized costs are evaluated for impairment in accordance with FASB ASC Topic 360, Accounting for the Impairment or Disposal of Long-Lived Assets (ASC Topic 360), whenever events or changes in circumstances indicate that an asset’s carrying
            amount may not be recoverable.<br/>
          </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af39" continuedAt="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af40"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10221" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10222">

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><span style="font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;"> <br/>
          </span></div>

</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af42" continuedAt="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af43"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10224" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10225">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><span style="font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;"> The
            fair values of proved properties are measured using valuation techniques consistent with the income approach, converting future cash flows to a single discounted amount. Significant inputs used to determine the fair values of proved properties
            include estimates of: (i) reserves; (ii) future operating; (iii) future commodity prices; and (iv) a market-based weighted average cost of capital rate. The underlying commodity prices embedded in the Company’s estimated cash flows are the
            product of a process that begins with applicable forward curve pricing, adjusted for estimated location and quality differentials, as well as other factors that Company management believes will impact realizable prices.<br/>
          </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af43" continuedAt="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af44"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10225" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10226">
<div><span style="font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"> </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af44" continuedAt="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af45"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10226" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10227">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><span style="font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;"> <br/>
          </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af45" continuedAt="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af46"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10227" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10228">
<div><span style="font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"> </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af46" continuedAt="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af47"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10228" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10229">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><span style="font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;"> To
            determine if a depletable unit is impaired, the carrying value of the depletable unit is compared to the undiscounted future net cash flows by applying management’s estimates of future oil and gas prices to the estimated future production of
            oil and gas reserves over the economic life of the property and deducting future costs. Future net cash flows are based upon third party reservoir engineers’ estimates of proved reserves and internal management estimates for probable and
            possible reserves. For a property determined to be impaired, an impairment loss equal to the difference between the carrying value and the estimated fair value of the impaired property will be recognized. Fair value, on a depletable unit basis,
            is estimated to be the present value of the aforementioned expected future net cash flows. Each part of this calculation is subject to a large degree of judgment, including the determination of the depletable units’ estimated reserves, future
            net cash flows and fair value. <ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsImpairmentOfOilAndGasProperties" id="Fact_887c4edff63c4c00a23dec673ac471b5" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" unitRef="U001" decimals="-3" scale="3" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen">No</ix:nonFraction> impairment expense recorded for the year ended December 31, 2024.<br/>
          </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af47" continuedAt="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af48"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10229" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10230">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><span style="font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;"> </span><br/>
          <span style="font-weight: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> <span style="font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;"> There were <ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:CapitalizedCostsOfUnprovedPropertiesExcludedFromAmortizationCumulative" id="Fact_fcb47fc687164bd7bdbdc240e828eca9" contextRef="c20241231" unitRef="U001" decimals="-3" scale="3" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen">no</ix:nonFraction> costs of unproved properties at December 31, 2024, and during the year ended December 31, 2024, the Company recognized <ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ExplorationAbandonmentAndImpairmentExpense" id="Fact_7791398a8222451e98da79610c903d5a" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" unitRef="U001" decimals="-3" scale="3" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen">no</ix:nonFraction> abandonment expense.</span></span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><span style="font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;"> <br/>
          </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af49" continuedAt="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af50"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10231" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10232">

</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

            <br/>
          </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af52" continuedAt="Text_af966eff319e4ad0b649dc9f2d4d80af53"><ix:continuation id="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10234" continuedAt="Text_e8f0ed3f0cca474c9c8710ce34496d10235">
